traceability.behavior_coverage: Explicit-ID declaration coverage remains primary when available; conservative Semantic Source Unit coverage is a separate no-ID mode.
traceability.no_id_explicit_coverage_semantics: N/A; numeric coverage/missing counts are null and evaluation state is separate
traceability.word_json_provenance_consistency: Canonical/Review JSON is the provenance truth; Main SWE.1 contains only Eligible items, while pending/cross-domain facts are physically separated into annexes.
traceability.semantic_source_classifier_ground_truth_: not claimed without human-labelled Gold units
traceability.no_id_provenance_completion: Eligible no-ID items require Semantic Source Unit + exact Source-backed Atomic Behavior; pending items retain behavior or Source Fact.
traceability.source_table_fact_join_policy: linked semantic unit or exact identifier overlap; numeric coincidence alone is insufficient
traceability.ordered_list_marker_policy: Ordered-list recognition is source-kind/context aware; table cells are not list-split by default, and decimal/version/date/specification literals must be preserved.
traceability.missing_owned_fragment_backfill: Only Source-owned fragments materially matching the requirement and not represented by existing atomic behaviors may be backfilled.
traceability.composite_behavior_fragmentation: Non-table composite prose may be conservatively decomposed into behavior-level Source Fact Fragments; ownership is matched against Canonical behavior content rather than broad whole-paragraph evidence.
traceability.fragment_ownership_allocation_rule: A Source Fact Fragment must not carry conflicting allocation/verification-domain claims across SRS; distinct behaviors require distinct fragment identity or ownership correction.
traceability.software_eligibility_semantics: Absence of non-software evidence is not software evidence; SWE.6 Eligible requires positive software allocation evidence.
traceability.raw_source_literal_preservation: Raw excerpt preserves detached closing punctuation; display normalization is separate.
traceability.provenance_audit: single structured Source-fact token stream + exact multi-fragment critical Fact Fragment ownership union with token-to-fragment evidence
traceability.critical_fragment_completion: V0.74 Source-bounded completion within already-matched Semantic Units or explicitly cited Source locations containing literal missing critical facts
traceability.semantic_disposition: REVIEW_NEEDED remains OPEN/non-terminal until linked or explicitly dispositioned
traceability.shared_fragment_disambiguation: Clear dominant parent only; ambiguous sharing remains SHARED_REVIEW_REQUIRED
traceability.unanalyzed_visual_gap: Only when requirement already declares visual dependency and no Vision evidence exists; no visual semantics inferred

regression.stable_source_key_basis: source location + normalized source fact text

testability.invariant: Automatic SWE.6 TC generation requires SWE.1/SWE.6 eligibility plus complete source provenance; source-backed child verification intents remain auditable without inventing concrete values.
testability.intent_coverage_policy: Executable Eligible-intent coverage and Deferred/Allocation governance are separate. Coverage must never be raised by inventing test data.
testability.table_fact_auto_use_policy: Only HIGH-confidence SINGLE_REQUIRED_VALUE or TIMING_CRITERION may populate TC Variable/Compare/Value; enum/range/encoding/invalid rows remain audit evidence.
testability.child_intent_independent_coverage: Requires a structured criterion relevant to the specific child intent; unrelated parent TC fields do not establish coverage.

gate_separation.external_dependency_semantics: An unresolved external specification may hold Artifact Readiness without automatically being a Tool Quality defect.

testability.mixed_domain_swe6_tc_scope: Concrete/generic SWE.6 TC assertions are limited to SWE.6-eligible fact fragments; SYS.5/external/pending facts remain excluded/deferred evidence.

review_exchange.evaluator_core_files: No fixed file-count limit in unified mode

review_exchange.actual_swe6_artifact_verification: Verifies copied file-03 XLSX, artifact SHA-256, R/S/T/U headers, and exact prepopulated result cells.
review_exchange.baseline_selection_policy: Exact-SHA approved Gold contract or protected legacy reference only; ordinary previous Review Exchange runs are ignored as release regression baselines.
review_exchange.capture_column_contract: U / Capture CANoe (Optional): header required, user value optional, pre-execution blank required.
review_exchange.evaluation_persistence: Status/evidence visible immediately; each reviewer persisted on completion; success only after on-disk verification.

known_limits: The bundled MLM Gold Contract is a compact behavior contract, not the full V0.46 Review Package.
The bundled confidential MLM Source is not included; Source SHA selects the compact contract.
Semantic Source Unit coverage is conservative; every eligible unit gets a disposition, but classifier precision/recall is not claimed without a human-labelled Gold unit set.
Allocation is a conservative review aid, not automatic ASPICE responsibility approval; ambiguous system behavior remains Review Needed.
A Cross-Document source is not automatically registered as Gold until a human-approved baseline is created.
Actual Missing behaviors remain release-blocking when explicit-ID coverage is applicable and a missing behavior is confirmed.
Numeric source literals with ambiguous relation are preserved rather than normalized into an invented comparator; human clarification may still be required.
Dedicated Timing/State/Variant TCs are not invented solely to raise intent coverage when source test evidence is insufficient.
GUI appearance/QFileSystemWatcher behavior requires Windows runtime confirmation.
Live H-Chat and direct-provider evaluation remain environment/policy dependent and were not exercised in this build environment.
Automatic unsupported-generation precheck is bounded and does not prove zero hallucination.
No-ID concrete SWE.6 generation is intentionally deferred when Semantic Source Unit / Atomic Behavior provenance is incomplete.
SWE.6 intent coverage is informative; deferred intents require reason codes and must not be converted to concrete tests by inventing missing source data.
Source-backed child intents improve auditability but do not mechanically force one concrete TC per atomic behavior.
Interface configuration facts remain pending allocation unless source-backed software responsibility is explicit.
SWE.6-specific export audit checks structural preservation and the actual Excel handoff, but does not prove physical bench executability without project-specific test environment evidence.
Cross-domain fact-level allocation preserves the parent bundle and does not automatically split SRS; human review may still choose later separation.
Child-intent status is an audit disposition, not proof of physical bench observability without project-specific instrumentation/test-environment evidence.
DERIVED verification-method candidates are engineering suggestions and must not be interpreted as Source requirements.
Allocation-pending deferred intent governance is auditable, but software responsibility remains a human/architecture allocation decision.
Source Table Fact auto-use requires HIGH-confidence semantic-unit or exact-identifier linkage; ambiguous multi-value rows remain Review/N/A/Deferred.
Repeated Explicit-ID Missing recovery requires at least two repeat-equivalent Missing declarations; single-occurrence Missing remains human-review blocking.
REPRESENTED_IN_GENERIC_TC does not imply independent observability or independent test coverage.

The no-ID [시스템사양서] same-source Gold contract is not bundled because an explicitly approved Gold contract was not supplied; register a human-approved package with [Gold Source 추가] before expecting a release regression PASS.

V0.67 generic regression validates fragment-to-child trace, minimum ownership, mixed-domain TC scope and automated-evaluation file/governance behavior, but real reference sources must be rerun locally for end-to-end confirmation.
Positive SW allocation is intentionally conservative; system/controller behaviors may move from SWE.6 Eligible to Deferred until software responsibility is explicitly evidenced or approved.
Tool Quality PASS does not imply Artifact Readiness PASS when external specifications, allocation decisions, or independent observability evidence are still missing.
Automated 3-AI consensus is an independent review aid and does not replace an approved Gold regression contract or required human approval.
A PARTIAL reviewer run preserves useful findings but is forced to Official Release HOLD.
When automatic evaluation is ON, the configured evidence package is transmitted to H-Chat or external provider APIs; organization/customer policy must permit that transmission.
Legacy V0.45 standard/duplicate/precise reviewer controls are intentionally retired; only the actual auto/manual/none evaluation contract remains.
Live Windows/H-Chat 3-provider evaluation was not executed in the build environment; V0.68 instead verifies persistence/failure behavior with deterministic mocked provider regression.
If a legacy external Requirement_Studio_Gold_Sources folder contains unexpected user files, V0.68 will not delete that folder automatically; it only stops future external writes.
REVIEW_NEEDED Semantic Units remain intentionally open until engineering linkage/disposition is resolved; V0.72 does not invent an owner, requirement, or allocation to close them.

automated_evaluation.semantic_disposition: REVIEW_NEEDED is OPEN/non-terminal until linked or explicitly dispositioned

automated_evaluation.critical_fragment_completion: Explicitly cited Source-location bounded; literal missing-token evidence required.
automated_evaluation.open_review_needed_classification: Explicit OPEN/non-terminal REVIEW_NEEDED is Artifact Readiness/Release Governance unless silent drop/false close or separate trace loss is proven.
